_note: Sampling settings: `steps`, `cfg` (CFG scale), `sampler`, `scheduler`, `negative`. Every engine has tested defaults (`jenair engines` lists them), so most jobs need none of this. To set them once for a whole file put them in `defaults` - see configs/full.json.

jobs._note: illustrious (SDXL) uses a negative prompt and CFG. A sampler name from a model card (Euler a, DPM++ 2M Karras, ...) works as it is and already includes its scheduler: do not add `scheduler` to it (an explicit `scheduler` always wins).
jobs.name: sdxl-settings
jobs.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, walking through a sunlit forest, long coat, looking up, leaves falling, soft light
jobs.negative: lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, watermark, text

jobs._note: The same with ComfyUI's own names.
jobs.name: sdxl-comfy-names
jobs.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, walking through a sunlit forest, long coat, looking up, leaves falling, soft light
jobs.negative: lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, watermark, text

jobs._note: krea2 runs at CFG 1 (turbo) and ignores `negative` there. Raise cfg above 1 to use a negative prompt; it then takes about twice as long per image.
jobs.name: krea2-negative
jobs.prompt: A rainy neon-lit street at night, reflections on wet asphalt, people with umbrellas, cinematic wide shot.

jobs._note: A speed LoRA changes how many steps are needed: 4 instead of qwen's 25.
jobs.name: qwen-4-steps
jobs.prompt: Black ink illustration of a lighthouse on a cliff during a storm, bold brush strokes, white paper background.

jobs._note: zimage, qwen and klein are distilled: CFG is fixed at 1 and there is no negative prompt. Only `steps` and `sampler` apply.
jobs.name: zimage-more-steps
jobs.prompt: A quiet neighborhood cafe at dawn, warm light through tall windows, steam rising from a cup on a wooden counter.
